title: fourteen figure files in docs/figures are referenced by nothing
author: Claude-JG
description: Twelve .pdf and two .eps files in docs/figures/ are referenced by no page, no definition and no tool: CommonTangents3D.eps, DrawSystemGraphExample.pdf, RotationAxisAngle.pdf, RotationAxisAngleDerivation.pdf, degrees_of_freedom.pdf, elementaryRotationX.pdf, elementaryRotationY.pdf, generalContactANCF2Dcircle.pdf, generalContactSpheres.pdf, open_closed_loop.pdf, plotSpringDamper.pdf, spectralRadiusZeta0.pdf, triangleNormal.eps, triangleNormal.pdf. They are the vector originals of the LaTeX era; most have a .png twin that IS used. Copies are in tmp/unusedFigures for the maintainer to look at (that directory is git-ignored, so nothing left version control). What has to be decided: delete them, or keep them as the editable source of the png twins - in which case they belong somewhere that says so. NOTE eleven further .pdf figures ARE referenced, but only inside \ignoreRST{} blocks in definitions/itemDefsObjects.py, i.e. only by the LaTeX build that no longer exists; the Markdown and the new PDF of revision2026b step RG3.3 use their png twins.
workingRemarks: Copies are in tmp/unusedFigures/ with a README naming the issue; the originals are untouched in docs/figures/ and still in git, because tmp/ is git-ignored and a move would have taken them out of version control. Waiting for the maintainer to look at them (revision2026b step RG3.8).; RG3.8.1 (2026-09-24): the maintainer drew ContactFrictionCircleCable2D.svg, ...stickingPos.svg and ...normals.svg, and the three figure directives in definitions/itemDefsObjects.py now read docs/figures/<name>.* - Sphinx picks the SVG for html and the PDF for LaTeX from one name, verified in the built html. Still open in RG3.8: the four lost figures (generalContactANCF2Dcircle, generalContactSpheres, ObjectJointALEmoving2D, intro2.jpg) and the further SVG conversions listed in the log.; RG3.8.2 (2026-09-25): pendulum, pendulumConstraint and RotationsSequences are .* candidates (they have no .pdf, so LaTeX uses the .png, which stays); the two kinematicTree images were screenshots of a typeset LaTeX algorithm and are the algorithms themselves again, written out of the old .tex; intro2.jpg is the title picture of the PDF, which pdfIndex.md carries; eight obsolete files removed. Both builders verified. Still open in RG3.8: generalContactANCF2Dcircle, generalContactSpheres and ObjectJointALEmoving2D, the three figures whose captions are lost, plus seven unreferenced .png found on the way (ObjectRigidBody, PrismaticJointX, RevoluteJointZ, RevoluteJointZ2, SphericalJoint, TutorialRigidBody1, UniversalJoint) and the older logo ExudynLOGO1.7.jpg.; revision2026b step RG3.8.4 done: the three figures the conversion lost are referenced again - generalContactSpheres and generalContactANCF2Dcircle in theoryContact.md, ObjectJointALEmoving2D in its item description - each as a .* candidate, checked in the PDF as well. What is left is RG3.8.5: seventeen figures exist as a png and as a pdf/eps and every reference names the png; switching to .* needs one comparison per pair first, because a pair that has drifted would show one picture in the HTML and another in the PDF with no warning.
